notes: Rule 82's *also* arm: the ASV writes a word of the particle's own for καί, so καθάπερ keeps *Even as* whole headed on *as* and the particle takes only *also*. Splitting *even* onto καί is the bare-*even* arm and does not apply where *also* is written.
s007 τοῦ takes *upon the*: the genitive is what the English preposition answers to under rule 21, λέγει τὸν μακαρισμόν being rendered *pronounceth blessing upon*.
s014 χωρίς keeps its trailing *from* under rule 101, the governed ἔργων having no determiner for an article to anchor; head on *apart* under rule 71.
